subject: Updated roster copy
text: Hi - sorry this is rushed. I need the updated volunteer roster before four, if you have it. My version still lists the old shift times, and I just spotted that the new hall needs a printable copy by six. Could you send the latest one, even as a PDF? Also, you suggested printing two copies for the help desk yesterday, which is a great idea. I will do that as soon as yours arrives. If it is easier, drop it in the shared folder and ping me. Thanks, sorry for the dash!
